title: Researcher: Grok generated ~6,700 sexually suggestive or "nudifying" images per hour on X between January 5 and January 6; 85% of Grok images are sexualized (Cecilia D'Anastasio/Bloomberg)
summary: Cecilia D'Anastasio / Bloomberg: Researcher: Grok generated ~6,700 sexually suggestive or “nudifying” images per hour on X between January 5 and January 6; 85% of Grok images are sexualized — Elon Musk's X has become a top site for images of people that have been non-consensually undressed by AI …
contentText:
Cecilia D'Anastasio / Bloomberg :

Researcher: Grok generated ~6,700 sexually suggestive or “nudifying” images per hour on X between January 5 and January 6; 85% of all Grok images are sexualized   —  Elon Musk's X has become a top site for images of people that have been non-consensually undressed by AI …
